body: Bought the case for my iPhone 16e, got the antique white color. But after just 2 weeks of use, there’s already a blue color stain around the edges. I think this is a result of rubbing against my jeans pocket where I always put it. If I had known this, I should have gotten the black color instead
translation: 为我的 iPhone 16e 购买了保护壳，颜色为古色古香的白色。但仅使用两周后，边缘就已经出现了蓝色污点。我认为这是由于我经常放牛仔裤的口袋摩擦造成的。如果我知道这一点，我应该选择黑色。

title: Disappointing product
body: The design is sleek and very pleasing to look at but provides very little actual protection. After a few drops the case now has heavy scuffs and scratches as a result. The MagSafe portion works well but if you need it for protection this is not a good product
translation: 该设计时尚、美观，但提供的实际保护很少。经过几次跌落后，外壳现在出现了严重的磨损和划痕。 MagSafe 部分效果很好，但如果您需要它来提供保护，那么这不是一个好产品

title: Buying a different one
body: Case back is all disformed
translation: 底盖全部变形

title: No protection
body: Case is cute but didn’t protect the back of my phone from shattering when dropped
translation: 手机壳很可爱，但不能保护我的手机背面在掉落时不碎裂。

title: Poor durability
body: The back is peeling off, after two months of normal use. I am pretty disappointed in this case unfortunately, as I had only dropped it once, the peeling is not from the drops for sure
translation: 正常使用两个月后，背面剥落。不幸的是，我对这种情况感到非常失望，因为我只掉落过一次，所以剥落肯定不是由掉落造成的。

title: Bright color fades quickly to dark & dirty
title_translation: 明亮的颜色很快就会褪色成暗色和脏色
body: It lasted 2 months before looking dark and dirty… when it arrived it was bright orange, but my husband puts it in and out of his pockets, and it didn’t hold up very well
translation: 它持续了两个月，然后看起来又暗又脏……当它到达时，它是亮橙色的，但我丈夫把它放进口袋里又从口袋里拿出来，它不太耐用。

title: Bad MagSafe on a nice case
title_translation: 漂亮的外壳上有坏的 MagSafe
body: After buying this seven months ago, the MagSafe back is cracked, warped, and ruined from general use. Overall, it’s a nice case, and I’m disappointed that it didn’t last
translation: 七个月前购买后，MagSafe 后背因一般使用而破裂、变形和损坏。总的来说，这是一个很好的案例，但我很失望它没有持续下去。

title: Nope
body: Sent back because it didn’t actually fit
translation: 因为实际不合适而被退回

title: Only had it 4 months
body: I’ve only had this 4 months and today I took my phone off my car magnet and the phone case magnet completely ripped out of my case!
translation: 我只用了 4 个月，今天我把手机从汽车磁铁上取下来，手机壳磁铁完全从我的手机壳上撕下来！

title: Thumbs down color faded
body: The color fades off of it very very fast. It’s a good product, but I would not recommend it
translation: 颜色褪得非常非常快。这是一个好产品，但我不会推荐它。

title: Good case. Missing important items for the screen protector application
title_translation: 好案例。缺少屏幕保护膜应用的重要项目。
body: The case is great but the screen protector that came with it did not come with any of the supplies it was supposed to. When the case arrives there is a QR code that shows you how to prepare the screen with a provided wipe, cloth, and dust removing sticker. My case came with none of those items
translation: 这个外壳很棒，但附带的屏幕保护膜没有附带任何应有的用品。当包装盒到达时，会有一个二维码，显示如何使用提供的擦拭布、布和除尘贴纸来准备屏幕。我的箱子里没有这些物品。

title: Too big
body: Not fit
translation: 不合适

title: I asked for a refund and instead you sent me the same phone case twice
title_translation: 我要求退款，但你却给我寄了两次同一个手机壳
body: Doesn’t have screen protector and is not worth buying
translation: 没有屏幕保护膜，不值得购买

title: Not wireless compatible
body: This case was not wireless compatible in my new 2026 Subaru Forester car
translation: 这款保护套与我的新款 2026 斯巴鲁森林人汽车不兼容。

title: Don’t buy
body: Don’t buy. Wasn’t the same color and very slim, and doesn’t have a port cover. And the screen protecter is trash. Went back to my old case
translation: 不要买。颜色不同，非常纤薄，并且没有端口盖。而且屏幕保护膜就是垃圾。回到我的旧案例。

title: Slippery
body: Ok case, fits my phone well but it's very slippery to hold. Returning for that reason
translation: 手机壳不错，很适合我的手机，但握起来很滑。就因为这个原因回来了。

title: Discolors quickly
body: It got dirty immediately and can’t be cleaned. Discolors quickly, I’ve only had it 3 months. However does a decent job of protecting the phone from drops
translation: 立刻就脏了，无法清洗。掉色很快，我才用了3个月。然而，在保护手机免受跌落影响方面做得不错吗？

title: Too snug ><
body: I ordered this case hoping it would fit my iPhone 16E cause it says it’s compatible, well it’s too compatible the case is a bit snug and presses my side buttons. I have to constantly swipe my phone out of emergency mode. Yikes!
translation: 我订购了这款手机壳，希望它能适合我的 iPhone 16E，因为它说它兼容，好吧，它太兼容了，手机壳有点贴身，按下我的侧面按钮。我必须不断地将手机退出紧急模式。哎呀！

title: does not protect anything. do not buy
title_translation: 不保护任何东西。不要购买
body: dropped from 3ft onto the corner. glass cracked and the display broke. phone is completely unusable now. terrible case do not buy
translation: 从3英尺高处掉到角落。玻璃破裂，显示屏破碎。手机现在完全无法使用。糟糕的案例，不要购买。

title: Stains and holds on to dirt badly
body: This product shockingly turned brown and black within one week of use along the edges of the case. Just the normal wear and tear of being in pockets and purses changed the color of the case and it wouldn’t come off when I tried to clean it. I’m leaving two stars because the case was protective but I would not recomen this light pink color
translation: 该产品在使用一周内，外壳边缘令人震惊地变成棕色和黑色。只是口袋和钱包中的正常磨损改变了外壳的颜色，当我试图清洁它时它不会脱落。我留下两颗星是因为这个盒子具有保护性，但我不会推荐这种浅粉色。

title: GETS DIRTY FAST! LIKE WITHIN LESS THAN 24hrs OF HAVING THIS ITEM!
title_translation: 弄脏得很快！而且不到24小时内就收到这个商品！
body: This cases is decent, it does the job protecting my phone but the issue I have with this is that this item instantly got dirty for only having it for a day. It doesn’t look aesthetically pleasing to the eye. Not ideal to have if you want to constantly clean your case. I’ve never had issue with this on d of color with my other case
translation: 这个保护壳还不错，能起到保护作用，但我觉得这东西只有一天就马上脏了。它看起来并不赏心悦目。如果你想一直清洁机壳，这可不是理想的选择。我在另一个机箱的D色上从没遇到过这个问题。

title: Discolors quickly
body: Received this at the end of April and within about a month or so it became discolored. It looked dirty so I tried cleaning it but that’s not the problem. It’s discolored! Decided to leave a review today as I was talking with a coworker who has the same case for her 17 promax and hers is discolored the same way. The case itself fits well. I dropped my phone once and there was no damage. If only it would hold color
translation: 四月底收到的，一个月左右就变色了。它看起来很脏，所以我尝试清洁它，但这不是问题。变色了！今天决定留下评论，因为我正在与一位同事交谈，她的 17 promax 也有同样的手机壳，而且她的手机壳也以同样的方式变色。表壳本身很合适。我的手机摔过一次，没有损坏。如果它能保持颜色就好了。

body: The back of my phone shattered while using this from falling out of my pocket while sitting down 😩
translation: 我用这个手机时，坐着的时候从口袋😩. 里掉出来，手机背面摔碎了

title: INFESTED WITH BUGS!!!!!
body: When I opened up the Amazon packaging everything looked normal, but upon opening the box that the phone case was in TONS of little larvae worm looking things fell out of the box and all over myself and my floor. The case is also not gold at all, more of a peach color. The smell was horrible and I ended up having to throw away the entire package because there were so many bugs inside of it. Absolutely disgusting
translation: 打开亚马逊包装时一切正常，但打开盒子时，手机壳里有大量小虫状的虫子，东西从盒子里掉出来，弄得到处都是我和地板。这个盒子其实也不是金色的，更像是桃色。味道非常难闻，我最后不得不把整个包裹扔掉，因为里面有太多虫子。真是恶心至极。

title: I regret buying
body: It’s so cheap looking and thin. Lots of other people are saying their screen broke and I believe them. The side rails are so small there’s no way it offers any protection. It would definitely scratch easily as well
translation: 看起来很廉价又薄。很多人说他们的屏幕坏了，我相信他们。侧栏太小，根本无法提供任何保护。它肯定也很容易. 被刮伤

title: Not like the photo
body: Desert Gold is not gold. Looks nothing like the photo. Its skin tone colored
translation: 沙漠黄金不是黄金。看起来和照片完全不像。它的肤色。

title: Not compatible for Magsafe
body: False advertisement case is NOT compatible with Magsafe do not waste your time or money if that is something that you are looking for. Magnet is trash my phone keeps sliding or falling out
translation: 虚假广告案件与Magsafe不兼容，如果你在寻找虚假广告，请不要浪费时间或金钱。磁石很糟糕，我的手机总是滑动或掉出来

title: Buy a beware
body: Does not protect foam body nor the lens
translation: 不保护泡沫体或镜头

title: Bs ad
body: Doesn’t fit the iPhone 13 Pro Max
translation: 无法安装 iPhone 13 Pro Max

title: Dissatisfied
body: Case was good at first but has since started coming apart. I have only had it a month. Very disappointed
translation: 盒子起初还不错，但后来开始散架。我才用了一个月。 非常失望。

title: Don’t buy I don’t recommend
body: This phone case is so bad it’s nothing like the photo the case is see through and the magnetic ring looks so bad and it’s all scratched up and the phone case makes my phone case seem cheap and it’s looks already used and I just got it and I paid extra to get it early
translation: 这个手机壳糟糕到完全不像照片，手机壳是透明的，磁环看起来很糟糕，满是划痕，手机壳让我的手机壳看起来很廉价，看起来已经用过了，我刚买了，还多付了钱提前买

title: Coating comes off
body: The top right corner messes up. I don’t what it is. Some type of coating. This is second one
translation: 右上角出错了。我不知道那是什么。某种涂层。这是第二次。

title: Camera Opening/Square not the right size
title_translation: 相机开口/方形尺寸不正确
body: The case did not fit over the camera portion of the phone correctly. We ordered the correct size case and the box reflected the same size. But something is off about the camera opening.. Unfortunately my daughter had already placed the screen protector on (which did fit) so we cannot return. Oh well!
translation: 该保护壳未正确贴合手机的摄像头部分。我们订购了正确尺寸的箱子，盒子的尺寸也相同。但相机的打开有些不对劲。. 不幸的是，我女儿已经贴上了屏幕保护膜（确实合适），所以我们无法返回。那好吧！

title: Got dirty fast
body: Works just fine cute but got dirty fast (less than 2 months old )
translation: 很好用，很可爱，但很快就脏了（不到 2 个月大）

title: Durability?
body: Magnet pulled a perfect circle broke 4 months
translation: 磁铁拉一个完美的圆4个月就坏了

title: Fingerprint magnet!
body: Fingerprint magnet. I guess you get what you pay for
translation: 指纹磁铁。我想你会得到你付出的代价

title: Decent case
body: decent quality case, this case arrived with a SUPFINE logo on the bottom right corner that is not pictured in the product images, i did not want this on my case and was decieved
translation: 质量不错的手机壳，这款手机壳右下角有 SUPFINE 标志，但产品图片中没有显示，我不想在我的手机壳上使用这个标志，结果被骗了。

title: Flimsy won’t last a year
body: I’ve been using this product since Oct 2025. Does what it’s supposed to do. However today the magnet broke right out of the case. Flimsy manufacturing issue. It should last longer
translation: 我自 2025 年 10 月以来一直在使用该产品。它发挥了应有的作用。然而今天磁铁直接从盒子里掉了出来。脆弱的制造问题。它应该持续更长时间。

title: Magnet part came off
body: Really like the look and color, plus the lip had protected the screen multiple times. However, the magnet part of the phone that my Apple wallet connects to completely disconnected from the case and now it’s pretty unusable. I know it’s cheap but that really did not last very long
translation: 真的很喜欢它的外观和颜色，而且嘴唇多次保护了屏幕。然而，我的苹果钱包所连接的手机磁铁部分与外壳完全断开，现在几乎无法使用。我知道它很便宜，但这种情况并没有持续很长时间。

title: No Camera Protector
body: I gave it two stars because the magnet works well and the case is nice. However, it comes with a front screen protector, but not one for the cameras in the back (which was the whole purpose of me buying another case, since my old one cracked)
translation: 我给了它两颗星，因为磁铁效果很好，而且外壳也很好。然而，它配备了一个前屏幕保护膜，但没有一个用于背面摄像头的保护膜（这就是我购买另一个保护壳的全部目的，因为我的旧保护壳破裂了）。

title: It’s ok
body: Well, I like the case ok but the screen protector arrived cracked in three places! Grrr!
translation: 嗯，我喜欢这个手机壳，但是屏幕保护膜到了三个地方就裂了！咕噜！

title: Cheaply made
body: The back of the case came off in a perfect circle were my magnetic pop socket was sitting haven’t even had this case long
translation: 机箱背面在磁性弹孔放置的地方成了一个完美的圆圈，我用这个盒子还没多久

title: Not well made
body: It was a great product for six months. The case protected the phone from many drops. The magnet holds very tight. And actually that is three problem. The magnetic grip is so good that the magnetic ring and inner disc completely separated from the case. Need to find a longer lasting solution
translation: 这产品用了六个月，效果非常好。保护壳保护了手机免受多次掉落。磁铁紧紧固定。实际上，这有三个问题。 磁性握把非常牢固，磁环和内盘完全脱离了外壳。需要找到更持久的解决方案。

title: Not as advertised
body: Not magnetic nor works with Qi (wireless) chargers, other than that being the main selling point, decent case price wise
translation: 不是磁性充电器，也不能用Qi（无线）充电器，除了这点是主要卖点，价格也不错

title: Poor quality screen protector
body: The screen protector is poor quality. Put it on and there’s 2 portions on the side that don’t even stick. Super disappointing but this will only get worse with time
translation: 屏幕保护膜质量很差。戴上去，侧面有两块根本粘不住。非常失望，但随着时间. 推移只会更糟
